title: Q-SPEC-01-focus-log: Keep the history of focus sets (program_focus_log)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "kernel_focus_log" -- workers/core/kernel/migrations workers/core/conformance/l2-records.json
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-01 section 4.2: `workers/core/kernel` keeps the current focus set in `kernel_focus` with the tick that wrote it and no history of earlier sets, so `workers/core/conformance/l2-records.json` lists `program_focus_log` as missing. Append each replaced focus set to a log table in the kernel module's own migration, bounded by retention, and map the record in `l2-records.json`.

size: S

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** changing how the focus set is ranked or allocated.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "kernel_focus_log" -- workers/core/kernel/migrations workers/core/conformance/l2-records.json` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.
